title: Revalidate source Jensen with possibly infinite expected loss
head: codex/research-online-jensen-migration
body:
The existing source Jensen reader left the meaning of E[X] exists and several producer/expectation boundaries implicit. This change explains ordinary finite Lebesgue coordinate means, their finite-dimensional equivalence to genuine Bochner Integrable X, and how the proof produces finite negative part before using a possibly infinite signed expectation.

One Orabona v10 Theorem2.9 (printedp11/PDF23) and one necessary negative-part library producer are revalidated. Both original headers and all proof bytes remain fixed. The producer obtains a genuinely integrable affine lower bound. The positive-infinite branch uses the produced finite negative part; the finite-positive branch actually constructs an integrable real representative and takes the mean in the original potentially nonclosed epigraph. No loss-integrability, closedness, lsc, full-dimensional-domain or finite-support-law premise is added. Actual finite-dimensional real normed measurable/Borel generality includes the source Euclidean model; principal-value and nonintegrable-zero mean conventions are excluded.

Production changes are a leading source/scope comment and the existing `online-jensen` reader subtree, including seven independently requested corrections. Two retained proofs, zero new proof code, production definitions or registry nodes. This accepts only the source Jensen endpoint and its prerequisite after distinct gates; Chapter2's mandatory total remains null/incomplete and the Chapters1-16 Goal stays active.

- Fresh focused/public-body elaboration and unchanged whole canary13proofs/3definitions/2probability instances: normalized nonconstant finite law with mean2/square expectation5; normalized geometric law with integrable input but infinite square expectation; nonclosed lower-dimensional loss domain under genuine probability.
- Complete20unique named axiom audit v2 includes both actual anonymous probability-instance constants, standard-three-or-none/no sorryAx; two native guards separately passed. Failed v1 namespace/instance-name lookups remain preserved, actual names retrieved, no target/body/test repair.
- Sequential combined root9088jobs/Tests9230jobs and full harness466tests/seven existing skips passed. These are fresh gate invocations with cached jobs, not a clean rebuild claim. Distinct automated blind reconstruction and source/contract/body/final reader roles recorded; no human/external/runtime-model attestation.
- Actual scoped compiled graph2nodes/350direct type/value edges, including definition references, not full/canary export. Clean lean-verified local site at `c3e359a8a56cb70982c2d558ac47541d9295e104`; two frozen shared canonical nodes and all10806old IDs/URLs retained, site checks and actual viewed first viewport passed.

Stacked on OPEN draft#162 at exact `2b4586db952b0e4ed0b7630f2d471c75a9af0f74`, not main. Exact stacked contributor gate passed for four production paths/one manifest; main-relative diagnostics still lack11other legacy contracts. Raw whitespace diagnostics on preserved logs remain failed; scoped code/JSON/scripts/docs passed with enumerated raw exceptions. Earlier accepted receipts are bound through exact raw snapshots. Global reference-index refresh was not run because it rewrites unrelated indices outside this window; actual scoped environment/read-only retrieval fresh. No merge, deployment or worktree retirement.
